Write code that reads a specific secret version or staged value using a concrete provider.

You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — AWS Secrets Manager:
  Service: AWS Secrets Manager
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: get_secret_value
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/retrieving-secrets.html

  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: GetSecretValue

  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/kms/secrets-manager/product-overview/overview

Option 4 — Doppler:

  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: secrets.download, secrets.get
  Setup hints: DOPPLER_TOKEN
  Official docs: https://docs.doppler.com/reference/api

output_text:
```python
from google.cloud import secretmanager
import os

def read_secret(secret_name: str, project_id: str, version_id: str = "latest"):
    """
    Read a secret value from Google Cloud Secret Manager
    
    Args:
        secret_name (str): The name of the secret
        project_id (str): The Google Cloud project ID
        version_id (str): The version of the secret to retrieve (default: "latest")
    
    Returns:
        str: The secret value
    """
    # Create the Secret Manager client
    client = secretmanager.SecretManagerServiceClient()
    
    # Build the resource name of the secret version
    name = f"projects/{project_id}/secrets/{secret_name}/versions/{version_id}"
    
    # Access the secret version
    response = client.access_secret_version(request={"name": name})
    
    # Return the secret payload
    return response.payload.data.decode("UTF-8")

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    secret_value = read_secret(
        secret_name="my-secret",
        project_id="my-project-id",
        version_id="1"
    )
    print(secret_value)
```
